HEADS UP, MOTORISTS!

The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) announced on Monday that its expanded number coding scheme will be suspended from December 23 to 25, 2025, and from December 29, 2025, to January 2, 2026.

The MMDA updated its advisory following Malacañang's announcement, declaring work suspension in government offices on Monday, December 29, 2025 and Friday, January 2, 2026. (Facebook/MMDA)
